task_instance: Set up a minimal Cloudflare Basin analytics workflow and verify it: enable a Basin Catalog on an R2 bucket and run a Basin SQL query (SELECT * FROM default.my_table LIMIT 10) against the resulting Iceberg table to confirm it returns rows.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is building/troubleshooting a live Cloudflare Basin workflow (Basin Pipelines, Catalog, SQL). Every concrete step in SKILL.md and the SQL/Catalog/Pipelines reference guides requires executing the Wrangler CLI (e.g. 'npx wrangler basin catalog enable', 'npx wrangler basin sql query ...') or issuing authenticated REST calls to the Basin SQL query endpoint. The office-assistant runtime cannot run shell commands, scripts, or any code, and cannot install software (npx/wrangler), so none of these can be invoked. Secondary blockers that would also prevent it even if a shell existed: it needs a real Cloudflare account with R2 plus a Basin SQL auth token (needs_credentials_or_account), live network access to Cloudflare services, and retrieval of the current Basin docs the skill insists on reading first (all documentation and endpoint links in SKILL.md and the reference files are replaced with unreachable placeholders, and web fetch/search is disallowed for this run). Writing the SQL text to a file would not constitute the deliverable because the skill requires an actually running, queryable workflow, which cannot be created or verified here.
evidence: Read /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/runs/20261031_real2/skills/r085/skills/basin/SKILL.md and references/sql/README.md; Glob listed all bundled reference files (catalog/, pipelines/, sql/ each with README/api/configuration/gotchas/patterns, plus skill-feedback.md) - the skill's own files are present, so the blocker is not missing skill files. SKILL.md 'Quick Start' and sql/README.md 'Quick Start'/'Connection Values' show the deliverable is executed via 'npx wrangler basin catalog enable', an exported WRANGLER_BASIN_SQL_AUTH_TOKEN, and 'npx wrangler basin sql query' or a REST call to the basin-sql query path. The runtime grants only text file read/write/edit and (disallowed this round) web access; it cannot execute the Wrangler CLI or any command, so the workflow cannot be created or a query result verified.
